name: Knee Circles
instructions: Stand with your legs together and hands by your waist.
Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructions_fr: Debout, les jambes jointes et les mains le long du corps.
Maintenant, déplacez vos genoux en mouvement circulaire tout en respirant normalement.
Répétez pour le nombre de répétitions recommandé.
instructions_it: Stai in piedi con le gambe unite e le mani sui fianchi.
Ora muovi le ginocchia in un movimento circolare mentre respiri normalmente.
Ripeti per il numero raccomandato di ripetizioni.
